description: Comprehensive monitoring dashboard for AI agent framework performance, tracking operations, token usage, costs, errors, and detailed trace analysis. Monitor agent health, response times, success rates, and resource consumption in real-time.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let agentNames = dynamic([$agentName]);
dependencies
| extend
    session_id = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.conversation.id"]),
    agent_name = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.name"])
| where isnotempty(session_id)
| where isnotempty(agent_name)
| where array_length(agentNames) > 0
| where agent_name in (agentNames)
// 1. Safely extract token counts from both customDimensions and customMeasurements
| extend InputTokens = coalesce(tolong(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]), tolong(customMeasurements["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]))
| extend OutputTokens = coalesce(tolong(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"]), tolong(customMeasurements["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"]))
// 2. Capture latest record fields AND sum individual token types per session
| summarize 
    arg_max(timestamp, *),
    Input_Tokens = sum(InputTokens),
    Output_Tokens = sum(OutputTokens),
    Total_Tokens = sum(InputTokens + OutputTokens)
  by session_id,agent_name
// 3. Parse input message history and output response from the latest record
| extend InputMsgs = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.input.messages"]))
| extend OutputMsgs = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.output.messages"]))
| extend FullConversationArray = array_concat(InputMsgs, OutputMsgs)
| mv-expand msg = FullConversationArray
| extend Role = tostring(msg.role)
| extend Content = tostring(msg.parts[0].content)
// 4. Filter for chat dialogue (ignoring system instructions & raw tool calls)
| where Role in ("user", "assistant") and isnotempty(Content)
| extend FormattedMessage = strcat(toupper(Role), ": ", Content)
// 5. Build the final unified table
| summarize 
    Complete_Conversation = make_list(FormattedMessage),
    Total_Messages = count(),
    Input_Tokens = take_any(Input_Tokens),
    Output_Tokens = take_any(Output_Tokens),
    Total_Tokens = take_any(Total_Tokens)
  by session_id,agent_name
| project session_id,agent_name,Complete_Conversation, Total_Messages, Input_Tokens, Output_Tokens, Total_Tokens
| order by Total_Messages desc

panels.description: Key performance indicators for agent operations including total operations executed, token consumption (input and output), and average response time across all agents.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let agentNames = dynamic([$agentName]);
dependencies 
| extend
    session_id = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.conversation.id"]),
    agent_name = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.name"])
| where isnotempty(session_id)
| where isnotempty(agent_name)
| where array_length(agentNames) > 0
| where agent_name in (agentNames)
| extend 
    input_tokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]),
    output_tokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"])
| summarize 
    ['Total Sessions'] = dcount(session_id),
    ['Total Input Tokens'] = sum(input_tokens),
    ['Total Output Tokens'] = sum(output_tokens),
    ['Total Tokens'] =  sum(input_tokens + output_tokens),
    ['Avg Response Time'] = round(avg(duration) / 1000, 2)

panels.title: Token Usage by Agent

panels.description: Bar chart estimating daily operational costs based on token consumption and model pricing. Rates are configurable in the query (example: $1.25 per 1M input tokens, $10 per 1M output tokens).

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let agentNames = dynamic([$agentName]);
dependencies 
| extend agent_name = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.name"])
| where isnotempty(agent_name)
| where array_length(agentNames) > 0
| where agent_name in (agentNames)
| extend 
    input_tokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]),
    output_tokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"]),
    cached_input_tokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens"])
| extend uncached_input_tokens = input_tokens - coalesce(cached_input_tokens, 0)
| extend
    // Adjust per-model rates. Defaults below are GPT-5 mini-class. Cached input is ~1/10 of uncached.
    uncached_cost = uncached_input_tokens * 0.00000025,        // $0.25 per 1M uncached input
    cached_cost   = coalesce(cached_input_tokens, 0) * 0.000000025, // $0.025 per 1M cached input
    output_cost   = output_tokens * 0.000002                   // $2 per 1M output
| summarize estimated_cost = sum(uncached_cost + cached_cost + output_cost) by bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Daily Cost Estimation

panels.description: Percentage of input tokens served from cache across LLM chat calls (gen_ai.operation.name == 'chat'). Cached input is ~1/10 the price of uncached, so a high hit rate directly reduces spend.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| extend op_name = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"])
| where op_name == "chat"
| extend in_tok = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]),
         cache_tok = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens"])
| summarize cache_hit_pct = round(sum(cache_tok) * 100.0 / sum(in_tok), 1)

panels.title: Cache Hit Rate (chat)

panels.description: Total input tokens served from prompt cache. Equivalent to ~90% of these tokens' uncached cost saved.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| extend op_name = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"])
| where op_name == "chat"
| extend cache_tok = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens"])
| summarize ['Tokens From Cache'] = sum(cache_tok)

panels.title: Tokens From Cache (chat)

panels.description: Distribution of LLM chat finish reasons. Common values: tool_calls (multi-step agent step), stop (completion), length (hit max_tokens), content_filter (safety).

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| extend op_name = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"]),
         finish = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.response.finish_reasons"])
| where op_name == "chat"
| where isnotempty(finish)
| summarize call_count = count() by finish

panels.title: Chat Finish Reasons

panels.description: p95 latency of LLM chat calls broken out by gen_ai.response.model. Surfaces silent model routing and per-model latency drift.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| extend op_name = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"]),
         model = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.response.model"])
| where op_name == "chat"
| extend model = iff(isempty(model), "(unknown)", model)
| summarize p95_ms = percentile(duration, 95) by bin(timestamp, $__interval), model
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Chat p95 Latency by Model

panels.description: Most-used tools by call count, with success rate and latency. Sortable.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| extend op_name = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"]),
         tool = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.tool.name"])
| where op_name == "execute_tool"
| where isnotempty(tool)
| summarize calls = count(),
    success_rate = round(countif(success == "True") * 100.0 / count(), 1),
    avg_duration_ms = round(avg(duration), 0),
    p95_duration_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 0)
    by tool
| order by calls desc
| take 30

dependencies
| where name contains "invoke_agent"
| extend agent_name = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.name"])
| where isnotempty(agent_name)
| summarize
    operations = count(),
    avg_duration = round(avg(duration) / 1000, 2),
    success_rate = round(countif(success == "True") * 100.0 / count(), 2)
    by agent_name
| order by operations desc

panels.title: Agent Performance Summary (Click to select one agent)

panels.description: State timeline visualization showing hourly agent activity levels over time, with color intensity representing operation count per hour for each agent to identify usage patterns.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let agentNames = dynamic([$agentName]);
let maxRows = 10;
let topAgents = dependencies
| where name contains "invoke_agent"
| extend agent_name = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.name"])
| where isnotempty(agent_name)
| where array_length(agentNames) > 0
| where agent_name in (agentNames)
| summarize cnt = count() by agent_name
| top maxRows by cnt
| project agent_name;
dependencies
| where name contains "invoke_agent"
| extend agent_name = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.name"])
| where isnotempty(agent_name)
| where agent_name in (topAgents)
| summarize operations_count = count() by bin(timestamp, 1h), agent_name
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Error Timeline

panels.description: Table displaying the 20 most recent failed agent operations with timestamp, agent name, error type, and duration to facilitate quick error analysis and debugging.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let agentNames = dynamic([$agentName]);
dependencies 
| where name contains "invoke_agent" and success == "False"
| extend 
    error_type = tostring(customDimensions["error.type"]),
    agent_name = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.name"])
| where isnotempty(agent_name)
| where array_length(agentNames) > 0
| where agent_name in (agentNames)
| project timestamp, agent_name, error_type, duration = round(duration / 1000, 2)
| order by timestamp desc
| limit 20

azureLogAnalytics.query:

| where isnotempty(agent_name)

dependencies
| where name contains "invoke_agent"
| extend Agent = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.name"])
| where isnotempty(Agent)

| where Agent in (agentNames)
